description: The team is planning a birthday party together.

calibrationQuestions.text: What is the planned time and location for the party?
How many guests will be invited?
What does each guest bring for a gift?
Where do you order the birthday cake?

voiceSamplePassage: I am recording this sample so Agent C can represent my voice during our birthday party planning meeting. We will discuss the venue, guest list, gifts, outfit theme, and catering. I will speak clearly and at a natural pace.
